title: THE SEAL NEVER SITS ON A CRATE
why: A check of the new random seal (v24.82, his order that the seal should spawn in random spots) found that it could land right on top of a crate: in 17 raids of 300 a crate stood within reach of the slab, at seed 308841 only 15 away and hidden under it. While the seal is uncut, holding E there cuts the seal instead of searching the crate, so the crate gave nothing and the cut alarm drew the machines. The seal roll now refuses any spot with a container within 120 of it (the reach of the cut plus the reach of a search) and rolls again. The roll stays on the raid own side stream, so the machines, containers and loot of a seed are exactly as before, both windows of a pair still get the same door, and the seal still moves all over the map. DEMO and CAREER are the same.
now: The seal never turns up on top of a crate, so E at a crate always searches it.

edits.replacement: G_SEAL_SPOT=sealSpot(map,FIXED_MAPS[mapIx],containers);   // v24.xx (sealfixa): never on top of a crate
